question: What is the meaning of disposal considerations in relation to end-of-life management?
description: Disposal considerations in relation to end-of-life management refer to the documentation on sorting, collecting, and treating objects during the end-of-life phase. This includes information on how products are handled and processed at the end of their life cycle, such as recycling, reuse, or disposal in landfills. The goal is to minimize environmental impact and ensure responsible waste management practices.
